topic: Sexuality, pathodiagnosis and criminality across Lehrbuch and Ich-Analyse
issue: The corpus contains both explicit diagnostic limits (for example, p alone must not diagnose male homosexuality) and historically strong sexual/pathodiagnostic/criminological claims in Ich-Analyse. Their scopes differ and must not be harmonized into either a modernized denial or an unrestricted clinical inference.
evidenceNeeded: Clinician/steward review of the exact scopes and historical status of the three doctrines.
